answers.question: Is TradeHQ real trading or a simulator?
answers.renderedAnswer: TradeHQ is a 100% simulator. Every trade uses virtual currency only — no real money is ever at risk and no actual securities transactions occur. (Educational simulation only — not financial advice.)

answers.question: Does TradeHQ provide financial advice?
answers.renderedAnswer: No. Nothing on TradeHQ — including educational mentor responses, market analysis or sector commentary — constitutes financial, investment, legal or tax advice. Always consult a qualified advisor for real-money decisions.

answers.question: Can I use TradeHQ commercially?
answers.renderedAnswer: No, not without prior written permission. The service is licensed for personal, educational use only. Scraping, reverse engineering and bot use are prohibited.

answers.question: Who is TradeHQ for?
answers.renderedAnswer: Beginners and students who want to learn how markets work without risking real capital. Especially designed with Sri Lankan students and South Asian beginner traders in mind.

limitation: Actual safe FAQ expansion only; no account, order, form or quiz submission. Answer collection does not establish substantive review.
